findings.claim: The blueprint claims 9 objectives for 8 single-objective MCQs; health-checks#o3 (how liveness and readiness groups are used by a platform, line 18) has no item. Q8, the only other health item, assesses health-checks#o2 (why other Actuator endpoints stay unexposed). A learner can score 100% without ever having met liveness/readiness groups, so the claimed coverage is false for that objective.
findings.recommendation: Remove health-checks#o3 from the objectives array, or add/replace an item on liveness vs readiness groups (e.g. which group a platform uses to restart vs to route traffic).

findings.claim: lab.json claims logging-in-spring#o1 ('Log with an SLF4J logger at the right level AND set levels per package with logging.level properties'). Task 3 has the learner paste a dictated log.warn line (README line 55 gives it verbatim, so even the level choice is made for them), and nothing in the lab has the learner set a logging.level property; the only logging.level values in the bundle are inside the shipped test annotations. Half of the claimed objective is never practiced.
findings.recommendation: Either add a small step that sets a per-package logging.level in application.properties with an observable effect, or narrow the claim to the practice check (the mastery check's Q5 already covers per-package levels) by dropping #o1 from the lab's objectives.
